summary: A dispatched lane executes its step as a derived workflow actor recorded by the dispatch operation from the lane identity, the attempt, and the authenticated host as current rows (CD-0242 D2). Under CD-0242 D5, Implement cannot accept its own result, so the owner's acceptance of a dispatched lane's completed result is compared against the recorded executing actor and the lane's own acceptance refuses; no further executing-actor distinctness exists. Attempts recorded before the lane actor read back unchanged.
title: the dispatched lane is the step's executing actor
